suite.doc:
Login test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the mobile number login form at https://customer.uat.graydev.in.
Form collects: mobile number (10-digit) + consent checkbox. There is NO email or password field — all tests use mobile number. On valid submission: calls checkMobilePost API → navigates to /verify.

Ported from gq_customer_ui_automation (Java/Selenium) — loginPageTest.java. Satisfies: TC-201, TC-207 to TC-220 (excluding TC-202 to TC-206 in left component suite)
Satisfies: B1 (mobile form, not email/password), B2 (full login coverage), B3 (UAT target), U1 (exact error messages), U3 (redirect assertions), S1 (credentials in variables file), O1 (dry-run safe), O2 (results output)

suite.doc:
OTP Verification test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the 4-digit OTP form at https://customer.uat.graydev.in/verify.
UAT fixed OTP: 9999 — applies to all mobile numbers (TN2 resolution). No SMS dependency. Tests run reliably in CI without a gateway. OTP timer: 180 seconds before the Resend OTP link becomes visible (T4 boundary). Resend OTP test is tagged "slow" and "resend" — excluded from default CI runs (TN1 resolution). Run with: robot --include resend tests/otp_tests.robot
Covers: - Field visibility and editability - Input validation (empty, short OTP) - Button enabled/disabled states - Wrong OTP toast notification - Valid OTP redirect with dashboard greeting - Back button navigation and mobile number clearing - Mobile number display on OTP page - OTP countdown timer text - Resend OTP flow (slow/manual tests skipped)
Ported from gq_customer_ui_automation (Java/Selenium). UAT rate limit: ~3 checkMobilePost calls per ~60s. Each test navigating to the OTP page uses a distinct mobile number. Navigate To OTP Page handles auto-retry on rate limit detection.
Satisfies: B2 (full OTP coverage), T3 (fixed OTP, no SMS), T4 (timer), T5 (4-digit OTP), U1 (exact error messages), U3 (redirect assertions), O1 (dry-run safe), O2 (results output), TN1, TN2

Login left panel component test suite for the GQ Customer Portal. Tests the branding/navigation panel on the left side of the login page. Ported from loginLeftComponentTest.java in gq_customer_ui_automation.
Left panel elements: - GrayQuest logo (SVG) - "Register for EMI Plans" headings - Subheading info paragraph - "Trusted by 5M+ Parents" image - Footer links: About Us, Privacy Policy, Terms & Conditions, Contact Us - Copyright notice
All tests share a single browser context — the left panel is static and does not change between interactions, so re-navigation is only done for new-tab tests. Suite Setup navigates to the login page once. Individual tests re-open the login page via Test Setup where new-tab handling requires a fresh context.
Satisfies: TC-101 to TC-109
